summary: Nakamoto completed mergers with BTC Inc. and UTXO Management on February 20, 2026, issuing 236,239,537 shares as merger consideration; as of February 25, 2026, basic shares outstanding were 683,451,950 and fully diluted shares outstanding were approximately 890,148,039.

As of March 31, 2026, shares outstanding increased significantly to 690,018,254 from 437,946,327 at December 31, 2025, primarily due to issuances in connection with the acquisitions of BTC Inc. (218,372,167 shares) and UTXO Management (23,833,674 shares), plus warrant exercises and RSA vestings net of cancellations and repurchases. No updated BTC holdings figure was explicitly stated in the excerpts provided.

Nakamoto Inc. restructured its Kraken USDT loan: the original December 2025 term sheet was superseded by a Restructured Loan of 210,000,000 USDT, then partially repaid by $45M (selling ~600 BTC), resulting in a new June Term Sheet with 165,000,000 USDT outstanding, secured by 3,805.112 BTC, maturing in two tranches (60M USDT Dec 4, 2026 and 105M USDT Jun 30, 2027). The company also announced a share repurchase program but no new share counts were stated.

As of December 31, 2025, Nakamoto Inc. held approximately 5,342 Bitcoin (down from 5,765 in the current model), valued at $467.5 million at $87,519/BTC; share counts and debt details are not explicitly stated in the excerpts provided.

Nakamoto signed merger agreements to acquire BTC Inc. and UTXO Management, with total consideration of up to approximately 363,589,816 shares of Nakamoto Common Stock (336,804,102 + 26,785,714), but neither merger has closed as of the filing date so no shares are yet outstanding or capital structure changes are finalized.

Four material changes from the current model: (1) BTC drops from 5,342 to 4,467 — the model's 5,342 was the Dec 31 2025 10-K figure; Q1 2026 sales of ~284 BTC and then ~600 BTC sold in early June 2026 to partially repay the Kraken loan brought holdings to ~4,467 BTC per bitcointreasuries.net and CEO Bailey's own June 11 8-K statement, beating CoinGecko's stale 5,058 figure. (2) Shares basic and diluted must be divided by 40 to reflect the 1-for-40 reverse stock split effective May 22 2026: the model's 690,018,254 basic becomes 17,402,048 (confirmed by Schedule 13D/A as of May 28 2026) and the 890,148,039 diluted (from the Feb 2026 8-K) is superseded by 892,723,519 pre-split as of Q1 end, equating to ~22,318,088 post-split. (3) Debt face of $165M is confirmed correct per the June 11 2026 8-K restructuring; the Kraken loan is straight USDT-denominated term debt with no conversion feature, so converts[] remains empty. (4) The reference values provided (bitcointreasuries.net 4,467 BTC; SEC-XBRL DEI 696,085,586 pre-split shares) are fully reconciled: the XBRL figure is pre-split (as of 2026-05-11, before the May 22 split) and divides cleanly to ~17.4M; bitcointreasuries.net wins on BTC count over CoinGecko because it reflects the post-June-sale balance corroborated by the primary 8-K disclosure.
